attributes.board_name: California Board of Registered Nursing (RN); Board of Vocational Nursing and Psychiatric Technicians (LVN)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses from a CE provider recognized by the Board of Registered Nursing (check the provider's CEP number); CME Category 1 and advanced college courses also count; no limit on home study
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt from the 30 hours during the first two years after initial licensure (first renewal after NCLEX), except the 1-hour implicit bias course.
rules.audit_note: All RNs are subject to random CE audits; keep certificates or grade slips for 4 years.

topics.who: licensees within the first 2 years after initial licensure

rules.notes: The license expires on the last day of the month after your birth month, every two years (Bus. & Prof. Code §2811(a)); the first license runs for two birthdays, not two years. Inactive status possible without CE. Course details are entered in BreEZe at renewal; certificates are shown only on audit.
rules.legal_basis: Title 16, California Code of Regulations, Section 1451; Bus. & Prof. Code §2811 (renewal date)

rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE required for the first renewal after the license is issued.
rules.audit_note: Do not send certificates; keep them 4 years and submit copies if audited.
rules.notes: LVNs are licensed by the separate Board of Vocational Nursing and Psychiatric Technicians (bvnpt.ca.gov). 30 hours completed within 2 years before renewal for an active license; inactive license needs no CE. Expiration basis not stated on the page read.
